To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the integration of measurement planning, data acquisition, and visual exploration tools in one framework can improve the quality control in the automotive industry.

the visual exploration of measurement data is a challenging task, and that the integration of measurement planning, data acquisition, and visual data analysis is a promising approach for quality assurance in the automotive industry.

we have successfully developed a client/server system, eMMA, for the visual inspection of automotive parts. eMMA provides an easy to use graphical user interface, which is based on the Java 3D API and which allows the visual inspection and exploration of the measurement data. eMMA is a client/server system that is platform independent.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the integration of measurement data management and visual inspection in an automotive context.
the development of a framework to support the visual exploration of measurement data in the automotive industry.
the development of a platform independent framework for the integration of visual inspection methods into the process chain of the automotive industry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
eMMA provides an integrated environment for the visual inspection of automotive products.
the eMMA framework provides a comprehensive and powerful solution for measurement planning, measurement data management and measurement data visualization for the automotive industry.
eMMA has the potential to become a valuable tool to support the quality control in the automotive industry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
eMMA is an open framework for visual inspection methods in automotive engineering.
eMMA is a platform independent, flexible and extendible tool that supports the automotive industry in the quality assurance of their products.
we have developed an integrated system for the management of measurements in automotive engineering.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to provide a comprehensive solution for quality assurance in the automotive industry by using a combination of state-of-the-art technologies and a platform-independent framework.
the integration of measurement planning, data acquisition, and visualization in a single framework enables a smooth transition from the design phase over manufacturing to quality control.
a visual quality control system can be implemented in a modular and platform independent way.
